liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Stander on the Mountain** (3 reviews): Reviewer singles out Bruce's Stander among first-set favorites, along with Friend of the Devil, Cold Rain and Cassidy; Reviewer likes Stander and thinks it and more of Bruce's songs should have stayed in rotation [14][18][23]
- **Wharf Rat** (3 reviews): Reviewer points to a big false start of Standing on the Moon that suddenly turns into Wharf Rat; Band plays a full measure of Standing on the Moon before dropping into Wharf Rat, which reviewer had never heard them do [15][17][23]
- **Victim or the Crime** (2 reviews): Reviewer calls Victim splendid, and also praises the Playin' into Dark Star jam; Reviewer finds Victim ambient and dark without going too deep [17][22]
- **Playin' in the Band** (1 review): Reviewer hears Playin' as fiery, with Bruce and Jerry playing well together [22]
- **Space** (1 review): Reviewer says the jam coming out of Space is worth the price of admission [14]

## Setlist highlights

- **Stander on the Mountain**: rare: 4 archived performances [24]
- **almost SOTM**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]

## The recordings

- **gd1990-11-01.aud.andrewf.82406.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 157 min [1]
- **gd1990-11-01.145663.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.millier.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 158 min [2]
- **gd1990-11-01.145544.sbd.miller.flac2496**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 158 min [3]
- **gd1990-11-01.138689.FOB.BK4011.Teitlebaum.Ammons.Noel.t-flac16**: source not stated; 22 songs; 165 min [5]
- **gd90-11-01.sbd.ladner.8068.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 160 min; rated 4/5 by 12 [7]. Said about its sound: Sound quality is decent, though the playing is rough at times [12]
- **gd1990-11-01.125953.mtx.dusborne.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 164 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [8]. Said about its sound: Matrix recording is described as full, airy and well balanced [22]

## Around the show

- Reviewer says this was the final night of the European tour and believes it was the last time the band played outside US/Canada [12]
- Reviewer says Jerry's voice is a bit shot, though playing and song selection are strong [15]
- Reviewer finds Jerry noticeably tired, while Bruce is strong and often the highlight [18]
- Trains back from Wembley stopped around 10:30, stranding many Americans; later trains were scheduled the next night [19]
- Reviewer says Wembley was definitely the tour's last show, and that it was their favorite of the tour, having also seen the Zenith shows [21]
- Reviewer says the band seemed spent after the Halloween show the night before, giving a below-average performance [12]
- Reviewer finds the Dark Star underdeveloped, fading out rather than reaching its potential, in an odd day-after-Halloween show [23]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1990-11-01.aud.andrewf.82406.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Andrew F; transferred by Andrew F; source: Nakamichi CM-300's with CP-4 shotgun capsules > Sony TC-D5M > Maxell MX-90's, with no Dolby. Set up at rear of floor just behind the lighting board, mics on… [1]. Also: Audience recording; a tape flip during Bruce's solo in Space was mended with no second source to patch it; Tracked for two discs so the long jam stays together, leaving the encore at the end of disc one [1]
- **gd1990-11-01.145663.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.millier.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Ultra Matrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) [2]. Also: UltraMatrix soundboard-based set, 16 bit/44.1, using patch sources from Teitlebaum, Ammons and Noel and pitch correction settings [2]
- **gd1990-11-01.145544.sbd.miller.flac2496**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Ultra Matrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) [3]. Also: Soundboard transfer in 24-bit/96k FLAC, with patches from Teitlebaum, Ammons and Noel and pitch correction applied [3]
- **gd1990-11-01.138689.FOB.BK4011.Teitlebaum.Ammons.Noel.t-flac16**: taped by Mark Teitlebaum; transferred by John Ammons and Joe Noel; source: flac16/48kHz ; Mark Teitlebaum FOB recording w/stand; B&K 4011 at 110 degrees ORTF > Neumann PS > Panasonic SV255; John Ammons [5]. Also: FOB source with Teitlebaum, Ammons and Noel credited; right channel dropouts in the second track were repaired [5]
- **gd90-11-01.sbd.ladner.8068.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD > DAT > CDR > WAV > SHNv3 [7]
- **gd1990-11-01.125953.mtx.dusborne.flac16**: transferred by Matrix by dusborne; source: 2 Source Matrix by dusborne; Soundboard (shinid:34651) Souce: SBD > DAT > CDR > WAV > SHNv3 and Audience (shinid:90994) Source: DAUD Schoeps CMC54 > vms 5u >… [8]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Wembley Arena - November 1, 1990](https://www.dead.net/show/november-1-1990) [25]
- Poster by gocollect.com: [Grateful Dead Wembley Arena HANDBILL 1990 Value - GoCollect](https://gocollect.com/concert-poster/grateful-dead-wembley-arena-handbill-1990) [26]
- Fan art by Boris: [Grateful Dead Live at Wembley Arena 1990](http://theblues-thatjazz.com/en/rock/1659-greatful-dead/15729-grateful-dead-live-at-wembley-arena-on-1990-11-01.html) [27]
